description: This Java test class 'FileFormatTest' verifies the behavior of the 'FileFormat' class, specifically its ability to detect different file formats based on filenames or extensions. It contains unit tests for formats like PEM, PFX, P12, and JKS, testing various filename variants to ensure correct detection.
